newsitem.title: CHINA: China August retail price inflation 5.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China August retail price inflation 5.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's retail price inflation rose 5.8 percent year-on-year in August, the State Statistical Bureau said on Wednesday.
The rate was up by 1.3 percent compared with the July rate of increase, it said.
It implied a revision in the July figure, which was previously reported as showing an increase of 5.8 percent.
The bureau attributed the first upturn in the inflation rate since February to rising vegetable and meat prices.
The bureau urged regional authorities to boost supplies of foodstuffs in the run-up to two major national holidays on September 27 and October 1 to prevent another upturn in retail prices.
